summary: Customer reported a color-contrast issue on an icon that passes manual check.
mechanism: Engine color-contrast validation misjudged an icon (false positive).
resolution: Engineering added suppression logic for this false positive in Site Scanner and WFA.

summary: Security team refused IP allowlisting for lower (non-prod) environments; customer asked how to use a custom header instead.
mechanism: Protected non-public lower environments block scanner traffic; IP allowlist rejected by customer security.
resolution: Support explained customer must supply header name/value which Eng attaches to the tenant's scanner traffic; customer never supplied it, closed.

summary: Site Scanner 'Dashboard' tab showed no data while 'All Properties' showed data.
mechanism: Front-end dashboard/summary page loading bug (cache clear did not help); resolved by a later UI release.
resolution: Fixed by subsequent large UI change; customer confirmed summary page loads.

summary: Unable to select self (or anyone) as reporter when creating JIRA tickets from Site Scanner (and WFA).
mechanism: Bug in the Jira integration reporter user lookup/selection in Site Scanner/WFA.
resolution: Escalated to Eng, fixed under CS-1256.

summary: New properties for UAT sites crawled 0 pages and could not be scanned; after fix crawl succeeded but scans showed failed pages.
mechanism: Non-public UAT sites only reachable from allowlisted/US IPs; Evinced side egress IP pool configuration was not applied correctly so traffic didn't come from the allowlisted IPs.
resolution: Evinced fixed config on its side (CS-1257) so crawler uses the static IP pool; customer allowlisted the IPs; scans then worked.
gt_class_doubt: Symptom is really class 2 (0 pages) then class 3 (failed pages).

summary: Follow-up to #159; customer confirmed the color-contrast false positive is resolved.
mechanism: Same as #159 (engine false positive).
resolution: Customer confirmed fix.

summary: Saving property settings failed with Content-Type error; also asked why scheduled scans got auto-enabled.
mechanism: Property save request in Edge sent form-urlencoded body, rejected by backend; Site Scanner only supported in Chrome. Scheduled scans were enabled by Evinced backend for a quarterly cadence.
resolution: Use Chrome; schedule explained as intentional quarterly cadence.
ui_signals: Cannot save property: - Content-Type 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8' is not supported

summary: Follow-up to #184: customer's architect unclear what header is needed.
mechanism: Same as #184.
resolution: Support clarified it is a request header configured on the customer's side (WAF rule) with a value the scanner sends; closed due to inactivity.

summary: Customer tried to limit crawl to English pages via language setting/regex; crawl seemed to hang and regex let non-English URLs through.
mechanism: Language/locale filter and include regex misunderstood; '/en' regex also matched 'enrollment'.
resolution: SE added regex rule; suggested List Mode (CSV of URLs); no further change at customer request.

summary: Customer asked why many color-contrast 'Needs Review' issues appear when screenshots show no issue.
mechanism: Needs Review = engine cannot determine background (e.g. image background); requires manual review.
resolution: Explained Needs Review semantics, negligible score impact, can be filtered.
ui_signals: Element's background color could not be determined because element contains an image

summary: Needed scanner access to protected QA/UAT sites (bot protection).
mechanism: Non-prod sites protected by PerimeterX bot protection / IP restrictions.
resolution: Evinced configured customer-supplied x-px-access-token header on scanner traffic (CS-1464); customer also allowlisted IP pool; crawls succeeded after.

summary: Color contrast flagged with background detected as white instead of blue gradient.
mechanism: Underlying axe color-contrast check fails to compute gradient background.
resolution: Explained it is an axe validation issue; offered masking; no fix.

summary: Request to show property/view name as top-level heading in UI.
mechanism: N/A - UX feature request.
resolution: Feature request logged; ticket closed.

summary: Customer asked how to set up headers so scanner does not trip bot alarms.
mechanism: Bot protection would block scanner traffic.
resolution: Customer allowlisted IP pool and supplied a custom header; Evinced configured header on its side.

summary: Customer thought a color-contrast finding persisted due to caching after a fix.
mechanism: No caching; the reported contrast issue was a genuine one elsewhere on the page (faint 'PU' rows).
resolution: Explained true positive location.

summary: 'Download CSV' export email never arrived.
mechanism: Export is delivered by email; customer's IronPort spam filter quarantined it.
resolution: Advised safelisting Evinced sender in spam filter.

summary: Customer asked how crawler discovered a deprecated /wine-guide/ path.
mechanism: Links present in an invisible <ol> list on many pages; crawler follows hidden links.
resolution: Eng identified source pages (CS-1589).

summary: Two-step (email then password) login could not be configured; scanner hit 'Not Found' after first step.
mechanism: Multi-step login unsupported by UI form; under Puppeteer the site produced unencoded redirect_uri leading to Not Found (automation detection suspected).
resolution: Evinced built a custom multiple-interactions login script and applied per property after debug call (CS-1737).
ui_signals: Not Found page after login step

summary: User could not add URLs/scan; saw graphs they didn't create.
mechanism: User account had Read-Only role in tenant.
resolution: Directed to tenant admin to change role.

summary: Request to name components via data attribute (data-skyui-core) instead of class names.
mechanism: Component grouping relies on class names; CSS-in-JS produces generated classes.
resolution: Feature request submitted.

summary: Customer confused by duplicate IDs in Site Scanner exports.
mechanism: Nested Interactive findings produce multiple rows per element ID (working as designed).
resolution: Explained; planned to flatten nested-interactive columns; closed stale.

summary: Component flagged with wrong CSS selector/bounding box not on the page.
mechanism: Unknown; selector no longer reproduced (page CSS may have changed).
resolution: Investigated under CS-1723; could not reproduce.

summary: User could not access Evinced account/scan link; sign-up loop.
mechanism: User was not a member of the tenant.
resolution: Ran add_user_to_tenant in Retool.

summary: Site Scanner flagged Non-interactive Focus Sequence on a map that WFA didn't.
mechanism: WFA requires 'Best Practices' option enabled; issue is flagged by both when enabled.
resolution: Explained setting difference.

summary: CSV exports looked garbled in Italian Excel; later ~15 properties missing after instance change.
mechanism: EU-locale Excel uses ';' list separator, so comma CSV misparses; missing properties were not transferred during tenant migration.
resolution: Use Google Sheets / change list separator; customer re-added properties.

summary: Properties had scores of 0 and 2 which seemed wrong.
mechanism: Score = 0.99^(sum issue damage / pages)*100; very many critical issues per page drive score to ~0.
resolution: Explained formula.

summary: Re-scanning same pages gave very different results; first scan captured an interstitial pop-up.
mechanism: Marketing pop-up/interstitial (Adobe Target mbox) rendered on some runs, scanner scanned pop-up instead of page.
resolution: Advised setting cookie (mboxDisable) via login-with-cookies settings or Evinced multiple-interactions config.

summary: Possible false negative: radio buttons without fieldset/legend not flagged.
mechanism: By design: grouping radios not required (implicitly grouped by name); rule intentionally not reported.
resolution: Explained (CS-1766).

summary: Highlighted properties filter on dashboard reportedly not working.
mechanism: Unknown; support could not reproduce.
resolution: Asked for clarification; no follow-up.

summary: Questioned 301 critical img-alt issues on selector img[align=right] not visible on site.
mechanism: Invisible img tag in footer without alt or aria-hidden is a genuine detection.
resolution: Recommended alt="" or aria-hidden.

summary: Color-contrast false positives in footer of shop.advisory.com; many potential FPs at elevated severity.
mechanism: (1) Optum custom severity mapping overrode Needs Review severities (bug, reverted); (2) footer starts at opacity 0.01 so is considered visible and tested before scroll-in animation.
resolution: Reverted severity mapping; advised customer to use initial opacity 0 (CS-1885).

summary: Component screenshots looked like mobile view in desktop dimensions; later two sites stopped scanning.
mechanism: Screenshot mechanism limitation with sticky menu/full-page stitching; separate scan failures fixed by Eng.
resolution: Explained screenshot limitation; Eng fixed scanning (CS-1843).
gt_class_doubt: Second part (sites not scanning) is class 1.

summary: Compare scans feature returned error.
mechanism: Compare scans is a deprecated beta feature no longer maintained.
resolution: Account owner communicated deprecation.

summary: Error when adding property to 'My Collection'.
mechanism: Front-end sent POST with undefined collection id.
resolution: Eng fixed; customer confirmed.

summary: Compare scans failing across all properties.
mechanism: Old beta compare tool not maintained/broken.
resolution: Team to restore; long-term replacement; closed without tracking.

summary: Creating property failed with 'not a valid domain'; scan found zero pages.
mechanism: Seed URL with deep path plus include regexes (with malformed '\.com/' segments) did not match crawled URLs; domain validation rejected path URL.
resolution: Switched property to List mode.
ui_signals: Cannot create property. <url> is not a valid domain

summary: UI header count of running crawls didn't match properties list; crawls running for hours.
mechanism: Header counted only some statuses; fix counts new/running/pending. Long-running crawls tracked separately (#802, CS-1808).
resolution: UI fix deployed (CS-1872).
gt_class_doubt: Long-running crawl part relates to class 1.

summary: User's instance stuck on loading screen; dashboard wouldn't load.
mechanism: Problems during user migration from one tenant to another.
resolution: Eng fixed user migration (CS-1861).

summary: Property dashboards errored 'Scan ... could not be found'; scheduled scans from 7/5 missing.
mechanism: Evinced deleted scans from Jun 20-Jul 17 containing a Needs Review processing bug and re-ran scans.
resolution: Explained; re-scans completed.
ui_signals: Error loading this property, redirecting to properties page

summary: Property failed to load in UI.
mechanism: Bug preventing properties with certain View configurations from loading.
resolution: Eng restored property and fixed globally (CS-1915).

summary: Crawl/score data appeared out of sync between All-props table and property page.
mechanism: Property page was filtered to a View; header doesn't reflect active filter.
resolution: Explained; feature request filed.

summary: Storybook UI issues reported; wanted only iframe component URLs scanned.
mechanism: Filtering the crawl with regex dropped component links (discovered via Storybook UI pages); iframes not scanned in nested form.
resolution: Created an 'iframes only (components)' View filter post-scan (CS-2022).

summary: Span skeleton loader flagged as interactive element.
mechanism: Detection considered valid (loader lacks semantics/live region).
resolution: Explained.

summary: Viewing homepage scan returned 502 Server Error JSON.
mechanism: Backend GET /url-sets/<id> returned 502 (transient GCP LB error).
resolution: Advised clear cache/incognito; worked for support.
ui_signals: The server encountered a temporary error and could not complete your request. Please try again in 30 seconds.

summary: Events view didn't seem to show the main events page.
mechanism: View filter working as expected.
resolution: Explained.

summary: 'Error loading scan' on issue-type page; persisted on a specific View.
mechanism: (1) Issue-type URL with backtick-quoted name broke loading (fixed CS-1980); (2) complex View (PSG) filter on large scan timed out.
resolution: Fix released; support adjusted view; Eng ticket for complex views.
